environment.description: Same application deployed behind AWS API Gateway (REST API type) with a request validator attached to the POST methods. The validator uses a JSON Schema model definition that enforces: 'Hostname' must match pattern '^[a-zA-Z0-9][a-zA-Z0-9\\-\\.]{0,252}$', 'Count' must be integer between 1-30, and 'Interface' property is NOT permitted in the schema (additionalProperties: false with only 'Hostname' and 'Count' defined). The API Gateway integration uses VPC Link to a private NLB. Request body passthrough behavior is set to 'NEVER' (rejects if content-type doesn't match model). The gateway returns 400 before the request reaches the backend if schema validation fails.
